title: docs(research): map selected bootstrap proof obligations
body:
## Summary

```text
bottleneck brief
  -> selected bootstrap obligation map
       retained cutoff/cap audits: #1956, #1965, #1990
       conditional BIT stock:     #2084, #2120
       conditional uniform time:  #2087
       fresh-field averaging:     #2097
       implementation and later-stage obligations remain
```

Add `docs/research/selected-bootstrap-scope-map.md` and one onboarding link. The map separates reviewed retained scopes from four pinned open proposals, ordinary BIT m=64 from complex m=73, sufficient coefficient caps from derived conditional coefficients, and time H2 from stock H3. It includes exact replay heads, commands, attribution and open next questions. No mathematical result is claimed as new.

Task `scope-navigation`, consolidation, priority revision 4; nonce `9540ac7c50e97c48ffce51501dabc841`. Scope refined to this proof-dependency map. Base and refreshed canonical main are `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2114#discussioncomment-18935479). PR #2133 already covers the P104 alternative and is credited rather than duplicated.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the bottleneck brief links the retained unknown-stock audit but provides no route through the newer conditional BIT coefficient, uniform-time and fresh-fiber results.
- **After:** the new map records each result's premises and exclusions, with exact pinned public source links. All seven registered replays passed on Linux x86_64 / CPython 3.12.15, including their declared controls. Four open-head replays used separate clean sparse worktrees:

| PR | Exact head | Package under `research/` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2084 | `8001a23b003bec5dff5e61edec907b652c475932` | `selected-bit-parent-reserve` |
| 2120 | `378593574261e0b0915e7e8a83147aa640274fc8` | `selected-bit-ceiling-free-stock` |
| 2087 | `b5ffc48e3dd5c92f591bdb4fabafa2c8e8b33970` | `selected-bootstrap-uniform-time` |
| 2097 | `1d3ee0926656d5260c6cb1c0b81964ffe9fe1377` | `selected-cover-fresh-fibers` |

Run `python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/PACKAGE` at each cited head. The three retained replays are `bootstrap-cutoff-carry`, `bootstrap-cutoff-time-space-split` and `selected-bootstrap-stock-audit` on the stated main.

Also passed:

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py
git diff --cached --check
```

All 65 workflow tests pass. The document's exact arithmetic snippet passes; changing its 6748 equality to 6749 fails. Eighteen relative file links and all four pinned Git source paths resolve. The selected record retains SHA256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

Pre-submission overlap covered 428 open PRs and 864 Discussion records with complete pagination at 22:35/22:36 UTC. The four cited open heads were rechecked unchanged. This is metadata coverage, not a novelty certificate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** documentation.

No selected record, priority allocation, frozen evidence or verifier is changed. Open-PR proofs remain proposals. Replaying their authors' checks is not an independently implemented mathematical audit or human review. The actual packet/compiler, completed-leaf, uniform-toll, hosting, precision/tape and later-stage obligations remain; no full selected cold replay, formal-kernel proof, hosted CI pass or new κ is claimed.

Mathematical credit remains with Josie Elliston, ToikY, Adam Gall, Nick Petalas, Sricharan Vagvala and the selected PR589/PR555, PR185/PR387, PR1094/PR1087 and cover/borrowing lineage documented in the map.
